title: Progressive Bayesian Confidence Architectures for Cold-Start Personal Health Analytics: Formalizing Early Insight Through Posterior Contraction and Risk-Aware Interpretation
summary: Personal health analytics systems face a persistent cold-start dilemma: users expect meaningful insights early in data collection, while conventional statistical inference requires data volumes that often exceed engagement horizons. Existing approaches either delay inference until fixed statistical thresholds are met -- leading to user disengagement -- or surface heuristic insights without formal uncertainty quantification, risking false confidence.
